nodes.description: Payable constructor of SimpleERC20 that sets token metadata, calls ServicePayer (external payable call) and mints the initial balance to the deployer.
Internal ERC20 function that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account]; performs unchecked-by-design uint256 addition in 0.8.x (checked).
Internal ERC20 transfer that validates sender/recipient and balances, debits sender and credits recipient in _balances.
Internal ERC20 function that writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decreases the caller's allowance, computing currentAllowance - amount.
Caller-controlled address obtained via _msgSender(); used as the mint recipient and as the owner in approval operations.
Mapping holding token balances per address; written by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping holding spender allowances; written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased on mint and decreased on burn.
External payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed inside the ServicePayer constructor with arbitrary feeReceiver address.
Arithmetic update of the total supply inside _mint.
Arithmetic credit of the recipient balance inside _transfer, executed after the sender debit and before the Transfer event.
Constructor parameter for the amount of tokens minted to the deployer.
Constructor parameter for the token name, forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Constructor parameter for the token symbol, forwarded to the ERC20 constructor.
Constructor parameter (address payable) that becomes the receiver of the external pay call.
Token amount parameter used by transfer/transferFrom/_transfer/_mint/_approve.
Destination address parameter of transfer/_transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom/_transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve/_approve.
Local variable in transferFrom holding _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before the subtraction.
Local variable in _transfer caching _balances[sender] before the debit.

edges.reason: The constructor invokes an external payable call to an attacker-supplied feeReceiver before the mint, allowing reentrant execution during construction.
After the external pay call the constructor mints initialBalance_ tokens, driving the supply arithmetic.
initialBalance_ flows into _mint amount and is added to _totalSupply and _balances.
_msgSender() is used as the mint recipient account.
name_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor and stored in _name.
symbol_ is forwarded to the ERC20 constructor and stored in _symbol.
feeReceiver_ is the target address of the external payable call, controlling which contract executes reentrantly.
_msgSender() is passed as the sender of the transfer.
transfer delegates the state-changing logic to _transfer.
amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance and added to the recipient balance.
recipient parameter is validated and used to credit _balances.
sender parameter is validated and used to debit _balances.
_transfer caches _balances[sender] into the senderBalance local variable.
senderBalance local is compared against amount and used in senderBalance - amount.
_transfer reaches the recipient balance addition _balances[recipient] += amount after the sender debit.
The recipient credit writes into the _balances state mapping.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances state mapping for the sender.
_mint reaches the total supply arithmetic _totalSupply += amount.
The supply addition writes into the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint credits the recipient in the _balances state mapping.
_msgSender() is used as the owner in _approve calls.
spender parameter is the allowance key written in _approve.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances state mapping.
transferFrom delegates the token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] into the currentAllowance local variable.
sender parameter indexes the allowance lookup in transferFrom.
currentAllowance - amount computes the new allowance, exposing subtraction arithmetic.
transferFrom calls _approve to store the reduced allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only amount parameter whose sole semantic effect is the arithmetic performed inside _mint.
Transient metadata argument fully consumed by the constructor call to ERC20.
Transient metadata argument fully consumed by the constructor call to ERC20.
Parameter is only used as the target of the external payable call, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
Generic value parameter whose dataflow resolves to the balance arithmetic inside _transfer.
Address parameter that only participates in the recipient balance update inside _transfer.
Address parameter that only participates in the sender balance read/write inside _transfer.
Address parameter used only as the allowance key inside _approve.
Temporary local holding an allowance value consumed by the subtraction in transferFrom.
Temporary local caching a balance value consumed by the debit arithmetic in _transfer.
